D1.strategy: Extract the verifier contract before edits: required files/paths, exact output format/order, numeric bounds, and stdout/text predicates.

D2.strategy: First response includes a real tool call. Before first edit: inspect likely solution file, inspect one failing verifier/test clue, run one minimal reproducer. Keep reads path-scoped and <=200 lines.

D4.strategy: Contract->reproduce->edit->proof. Capture exact failing signature first. If one signature repeats twice, pivot hypothesis class. For repeated process/runtime signatures, freeze logic edits and patch runner/entrypoint/args/env/build-target first, then require one bounded smoke exit 0 before returning to logic edits.

D5.strategy: Keep memory to recurring verifier signatures plus one proven guardrail per failure class. Drop duplicates, stale speculation, and disproved hypotheses after two unchanged signatures.

D6.strategy: After each output-affecting edit and before final response, run the exact failing producer/test command, assert required outputs with test -s, and run one predicate-level format/content/stdout probe tied to the failing assertion. Block completion if any check fails.

distilled_patterns.description: Missing or malformed output artifacts remain the dominant live failure mode.
distilled_patterns.effect: Use a hard artifact gate per output-affecting edit: exact failing command + required file existence/non-empty checks + one failing-predicate probe before further edits or finalization.

distilled_patterns.description: Repeated process/runtime signatures plateau when logic edits start before runner wiring is healthy.
distilled_patterns.effect: After two identical process/runtime signatures, patch only runner/entrypoint/args/env/build-target and require one bounded smoke exit 0 before algorithm edits.

distilled_patterns.description: One-test-left plateaus need forced hypothesis pivots when the same signature repeats.
distilled_patterns.effect: If one failing test repeats twice, rotate hypothesis class (contract/path, runtime/env, algorithm/perf) and rerun only that failing test to confirm delta before broad checks.
